metadata.source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year Data Profiles & Essex County 2026 Certified Rolls

zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Radcliffe & Highfield Section, Yanticaw & Town Center Core, Spring Garden & Booth Section, Avondale & Passaic River Waterfront
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 2.844%, with an equalization ratio of 78.4%.
Public education represents 52.8% of property taxes, while municipal operations account for 31.4%.
Average residential assessment is $439,040, producing an average annual tax bill of $12,486.3.

neighborhoods.name: Radcliffe & Highfield Section
neighborhoods.character: Stately colonials, manicured lawns, and quiet residential lanes near Radcliffe School and Montclair border
neighborhoods.description: Prestigious western residential section characterized by mature oaks, custom homes, and high property values.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: High assessed residential values generating major share of municipal school levy.

neighborhoods.name: Yanticaw & Town Center Core
neighborhoods.character: Walkable town center surrounding Franklin Avenue shopping, Town Hall, and scenic 28-acre Yanticaw Park
neighborhoods.description: Civic heart of Nutley featuring Franklin Avenue dining, historic Carnegie Library, and Yanticaw Park pond.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Balanced mix of retail stores, medical offices, and traditional single-family residences.

neighborhoods.name: Spring Garden & Booth Section
neighborhoods.character: Suburban family neighborhood with well-maintained cape cods, ranches, and colonials near Spring Garden School
neighborhoods.description: Popular family section bordering Clifton, offering excellent walkability to community elementary schools.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Stable property valuations with low tax appeal litigation.

neighborhoods.name: Avondale & Passaic River Waterfront
neighborhoods.character: Historic eastern residential section near the Passaic River, ON3 bioscience campus redevelopment corridor
neighborhoods.description: Eastern gateway bordering ON3 (former Hoffmann-La Roche campus), experiencing major bioscience and medical school ratable expansion.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: ON3 redevelopment PILOT payments provide crucial non-residential revenue to Nutley township.

equityAnalysis.summary: Nutley Township maintains a certified residential tax roll across its neighborhoods.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Nutley Township, homeowners pay an average of $12,486.3 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 10.84% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 78.4%, assessed values average ~78.4% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 52.8% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 31.4%, and Essex County claims 15.8%.
